title: Cap. V Obj. 5: predestination without foresight of faith fights the nature and titles of eternal life
pass_a_gloss: Objection 5. Predestination which is supposed made not from foresight of faith fights with the nature of eternal life, and with the titles by which it is marked in the Scriptures: It is called the inheritance of sons (but only believers are), a wage, a reward, a crown of justice: Therefore it is not destinated to anyone apart from all consideration and intuition of faith and obedience.
pass_b_english: Obj. 5. Predestination supposed without foresight of faith fights the nature of eternal life and the titles Scripture gives it: inheritance of sons (but only believers are), wage, reward, crown of justice. Therefore it is destinated to no one apart from all consideration and intuition of faith and obedience.
source_text: Obj. 5. Praedestinatio quae supponitur facta non ex praevisione fidei, pugnat cum natura vitae aeternae, et titulis quibus illa in Scripturis insignitur: Vocatur haereditas filiorum (at soli credentes sunt), merces, praemium, corona justitiae: Ergo non destinatur cuiquam citra omnem considerationem et intuitum fidei et obedientiae.
